notes.title: Update C4!
notes.notes:
And here I am again! It's been a while since I wrote descriptions for updates, but today is a special case.
A lot of work has been done, almost a whole game has been created)
List of changes:
-The house has been completely redone. Now you can move around on your own feet, as well as interact with interior items.
-Construction system. You can arrange and use furniture, decorate your home. At the moment, the choice of furniture is small, but I will add new furniture and decorations soon. Some things can be used.
- Tasks. Going to work, you will have a task, after completing which you will receive a reward. Some tasks need to be completed in one day. there are 7 types of tasks, you can get acquainted with them right in the game. New ones will be added in the future.
-A lot of edits and improvements.
-I'll tell you in confidence that the mining farm has already been completely made, I'll add it to the game a little later. And also a plant farm and a moonshine still are almost made. This will allow you to get extra money and food.
Thanks! Happy New Year!

notes.title: Update C3
notes.notes:
Hi! Haven't had any updates for a long time? Sorry. I closed my debts at the university) 
I did a lot of things, I probably won't even remember everything, but I'll tell you about the main thing.
1. New mechanics.
Now customers can be offered to buy a package and a product for the promotion. For the sale of each item, you will receive a cash bonus.
2. Many improvements. Very much.
Improved many aspects of the game that both you and I didn't like. The changes affected both the house and the store. You'd better take a look at it yourself.
3. New game mode
There is a free mode, infinite. Well suited for familiarizing yourself with all the mechanics of the game.
4. Bug fixes.
Fixed a few bugs. I hope I didn't add any new ones)
Achievements have been redone, now they should be credited normally. BUT! Perhaps not all of them. If there are any problems, please let me know.

Thank you to everyone who plays, offers their ideas, points out bugs, evaluates the game, writes reviews. It motivates me a lot. I can't say when the next update will be, but I think it will be soon. All the best to you! <3

notes.title: Update C2
notes.notes:
In addition to fixes and minor improvements, two things have been added:
1) The store is no longer empty. Now customers come and choose products.
In general, it is strange that I did not do this in the first version. But now it's there and it's great.
2) Served customers now leave with a package of purchased goods, and not empty-handed as before.
I blame myself for the fact that this thing was also not in the first version.
I decided to slightly reconsider my views on the release of updates. At the moment, I want to release updates not as before, once a month, but as far as possible. But C1 came out yesterday. And today it's C2. Thank you very much for your suggestions and feedback. I read your every message and write down your requests and ideas. Of the important proposed ideas need to change the layout of the control keys. The person who asked for this, I'm sorry) Still not going to do it, but I will do it. We have a Discord, all links are in the main menu of the game, come in, I will be glad to see you and chat. You can also take the survey anonymously, even if you don't need to specify your email address. Thank you! You are the best)
Sorry for my English)

notes.title: Update C
notes.notes:
Straight to the point. List of changes:
-The restructuring of the store, many improvements.
-There's security at the store.
- The character has a body! Have fun spinning on the chair!
-The door to the store and the background of the city. Beauty.
- Removed motion blur.
- Improved graphics
- Customize the graphics for yourself in the settings.
Maybe I forgot something, see for yourself the changes right in the game! Thank you and good luck!

notes.title: Improved performance
notes.notes: A small update is already available for download, now it will be more pleasant to play on weak computers. In the settings, using the beautiful-fast button, you can select the level of graphics. Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Update C
notes.notes:
Hi! The year 2021 has arrived! I congratulate you all and wish you all the best in the new year, let all your dreams come true!
This is the first update in the new year, hope you enjoy it. What has changed:
1) There were decorations. Now you can decorate your apartment, put up a Christmas tree, hang garlands, curtains and paintings.
2) Decorations can be purchased, every day you have three decorations available for purchase.
3) Decorations give various bonuses that affect both life and work.
4) After a working day, you may receive a package, opening it, you may get decorations, money, upgrades and skill points.
5) When you hover over objects that you can interact with, hints are shown.
6) The loading screen appeared. And how did we live without him?
7) The letters have a background, it is more pleasant to read.
8) Minor improvements and bug fixes.
Thank you all for showing interest in the game, finding bugs, and offering your ideas. Enjoy the game!

notes.title: The update B is here!
notes.notes:
The second month is over, the second update is already here and there is much more to come!
This update was the most difficult for us, we made the game better and all thanks to You, dear players! I would like to thank You for your support, criticism, and suggestions. You are the one who makes this game better! Well, everyone was thanked, and now let's look at the latest update!

IMPORTANT! Read point 12!

1. the sky Appeared and it is a miracle. Now it doesn't feel like you're working all night. Now as it should be, you start working in the afternoon, in the evening you admire the sunset, and in the dark you finish your hard working day: 3
2. With constant testing I found one small but very nasty bug. When playing without sound, it was not clear whether the product was already scanned or not. We solved this problem quite easily. The scanner now has an indicator. So simply.
3. from now on, there is a choice. Go to work on foot or buy a bus ticket, thereby getting an extra hour of free time.
4. We fixed all known bugs. All bugs were found by You. Thank You for that. No more jokes with time)
5. Appeared instant notification of violations. Now you will be immediately notified that you are doing something wrong. In order to become better.
6. History? What? To be honest, we didn't plan the story in this update. But we've already added something) Now, as the game progresses, you will get a little acquainted with the history of the 4etverochka store, as well as the world of the game.
7. In the skill menu now has a scale experience. No more secrets)
8. The complexity of the game increases with each passing day, beginners to like it.
9. Daily emails from work. Check your email in the apartment, there may be something interesting.
10. We added graphics settings. At the touch of a button, you can choose between speed and beauty.
11. For your requests appeared the adjustment of mouse sensitivity.
12. IMPORTANT! We shared the manipulation of money! Take money on F, put it on Spacebar!
13. the Apartment no longer feels like a simple picture. Take a look at it for yourself in the game)
14. the Last point. Adequate results window of the working day. That's about it.

Once again, thank you very much to each player! You are the best! If I do not die heroically from the coronavirus, I will continue to please You with new updates.

notes.title: Meet The "Update A"!
notes.notes:
Meet the first major update! The list of changes is huge, let's briefly run through the main innovations.

Now customers have a voice, hair on their head and a desire to buy something at the checkout! From now on, they can ask You for a fresh newspaper or a pack of cigarettes. Also, during a pandemic, every customer must wear a mask. If the buyer is not wearing a mask, then you are forbidden to serve him - click on the red button, then the police will deal with the violator.
The products have an expiration date and You need to check it to avoid selling expired products. Overdue items must be put in a return container.
And for players who find the game too simple, we've added a hardmod. In the hard mode, you will not initially have a scanner, the function of showing the money deposited by the buyer and the change. The fines will be higher and the salary will be lower.
At home, you can unlock new skills such as:
-Scanner
- Showing change
- Display of deposited money
- Scanner speed
- Chance of a damaged article
-The speed of scale
- Increased salary
- Reduced fines
- Increased amount of experience gained
